name: Vrijland
description: Drama series for children about love, mischief and adventure starring Sietske van der Bijl and Kim Coelewij.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Daantje has too much stuff for a weekend of sailing. Soraya and Marjolein are bummed that they're too young for the twirling competition.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Annemoon, Jochem, and Jesse are startled by a noise from Kriek's house. Mo and Gerben are sent away by Officer Spoor.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Bente has lost Jazzy and is searching for her all over the farm. Soraya and Marjolein hear they're allowed to participate in a twirling competition after all. Jesse, Jochem, and Annemoon have to cross a ditch covered only by planks.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Gerben, Mo, and Sander play Rock, Paper, Scissors to see who has to complete the challenge at Kriek's house. Annemoon and Jesse cross the bridge. Jochem doesn't dare to cross the ditch.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Chantal discovers that the Vrijlanders are going to the haunted house. Mirhte is really looking forward to the vacation. Then she discovers that the boat is leaking.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: The children hide when they hear a bang in Kriek's house. Daantje and Mirthe take everything out of the boat to search for the leak.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Timon and Guus are caught with the crowbar. Annemoon, Jochem, and Jesse hide in the hay to come up with a plan.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Jochem finds a cat collar at Kriek's house. Chantal wants to help Soraya and Marjolein twirl. Soraya is enthusiastic, but Marjolein isn't.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Gerben comes to help Daantje. He dives into the water to look for the leak in the boat. Soraya convinces Marjolein to let Chantal help her twirl.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Emma and Wouter arrive in Rijland with a moving van. Emma doesn't like it at all (the village, the house, her room). Grandma Gwen promises to make new outfits for Soraya and Marjolein for the twirling.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Bente has lost Jazzy again. Sander puts Chantal behind the counter at the snack bar so he can go to Kriek. Emma misses her mother.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Mo picks a flower for Mirthe and wants to declare his love for her. Emma grumbles about the village. There isn't even a ballet school.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Chantal practices modeling poses at the snack bar, but is caught by Arie. Wouter is still searching for the ballet school. Mo sings under Mirthe's window.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: Jochem and Jesse climb through the window into Kriek's house. Gerben and Mo help Hans; Mo tries to help with the cows. Emma says she's going to run away.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Soraya can no longer dance, and Marjolein feels guilty. Annemoon, Jochem, and Jesse find something in Kriek's house. Wouter is looking for Emma; she's gone.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: Chantal goes to help Bente find Jazzy. Timon and Guus also go to Kriek's house. Soraya and her grandmother Gwen play a prank on Marjolein.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: Sander is still trying to open the gate at Kriek's house when Gerben and Mo suddenly appear on the other side. Emma is waiting at the bus stop to leave the village.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: Gerben and Mo manage to get Officer Spoor away from Kriek's house. Meanwhile, Annemoon, Jochem, and Jesse are still inside when they hear a bang. The day of the twirling competition has arrived.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: Emma's father won't let her go shopping in town with Anne. Gerben and Mo find Sander unconscious at Kriek's house.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: Arie is angry with Sander because he left the snack bar during work. Mo tells Sander he's going to ask Mirthe out.

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: Wouter is having trouble with his scooter. Timon and Guus are spying on Annemoon & Co. Sander, Gerben, and Mo come up with a new challenge. They're going to visit the new family.

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: Guus and Timon enter Kriek's house. Guus first throws a smoke bomb to scare away the ghosts. Mirthe goes home with Chantal. Daantje can go work at the snack bar.

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: Mo introduces herself to Jannetje as the village charmer. Daan waits by the boat and calls Mirthe.

videos.title: Episode 25
videos.overview: Mirthe leaves Chantal's house in fright. She's far too late. Sander, Gerben, and Mo are hiding in the grass at the villa, keeping watch.

videos.title: Episode 26
videos.overview: Bente thinks Jannetje doesn't like her. Her mother reassures her: she needs time. They're going to bake cookies for Jannetje. Soraya wants to visit Emma with Marjolein.

videos.title: Episode 27
videos.overview: Annemoon, Jochem, and Jesse are being watched by Timon and Guus. Mirthe is practicing modeling poses for a shop window. Mo wants to give her a flower.

videos.title: Episode 28
videos.overview: Bente comes home without groceries. It turns out Jannetje took her bag. Arie is angry that Sander left work again.

videos.title: Episode 29
videos.overview: Chantal wants to go to town for new clothes and asks Mirthe for money. The mailman delivers a letter to the snack bar run by the fries committee.

videos.title: Episode 30
videos.overview: Grandma Gwen persuades Soraya to ask Marjolein to come with her to Emma's house again. Annemoon is worried that the other animals won't be happy with the cats.

videos.title: Episode 32
videos.overview: Marjolein's father confesses that he's lost his job and they can no longer go on vacation. Sander tells Chantal about the French fry committee. The cats have turned everything upside down in the workshop.

videos.title: Episode 33
videos.overview: Timon and Guus have a water fight near the police car, and the antenna breaks off. Mirthe comes to borrow Daantje's camera for the photoshoot with Chantal.

videos.title: Episode 34
videos.overview: Bente wants to come up with something fun for Jannetje. Mo unknowingly gives her the idea of ​​the moped. Sander tries out all sorts of fries for the fries committee. Mo and Gerben have to try everything.

videos.title: Episode 35
videos.overview: Mo discovers his moped is missing. He goes looking for Bente and asks Jannetje for help. Gerben and Daantje go looking for costumes.

videos.title: Episode 36
videos.overview: Soraya visits Emma again. She pretends not to do ballet. Marjolein manages to sneak the tent away. She sets it up in the meadow with her father and Soraya.

videos.title: Episode 37
videos.overview: Emma wants to go to Disneyland Paris with her friends for her birthday. Now she just has to convince her father. Gerben sneaks Sander away from the snack bar. The boys say mopeds aren't for girls.

videos.title: Episode 38
videos.overview: The tent is up. Father Wiebe is going to pick up Mother. Soraya and Marjolein are going to make things cozy. Marjolein and Soraya are trying to think of something for the party at the "campsite."

videos.title: Episode 39
videos.overview: Mirthe confesses to Daantje that she lent Chantal the money. Melchior suggests Emma throw a fantastic party at her house.

videos.title: Episode 40
videos.overview: Soraya convinces Marjolein to give Emma another chance. Mirthe asks Chantal for her money back. Gerben and Mo are looking for a new challenge. Jannetje gets involved.

videos.title: Episode 42
videos.overview: Jannetje drops by Gerben and Mo's hangout. She wants to arm wrestle Mo. Chantal thinks the fries committee is a scout and tries her best.

videos.title: Episode 43
videos.overview: Daan goes to Mirthe to talk to her about the money, but they don't understand each other. Mo and Gerben have to tell Sander that Mo has promised Jannetje a challenge.

videos.title: Episode 44
videos.overview: Annemoon thinks her mother needs a husband. Sander gets angry when he hears Jannetje is being challenged. Gerben comes up with a plan.

videos.title: Episode 45
videos.overview: Timon looks for Guus in the caravan, but he's already gone. Marjolein and Soraya eat sushi for the first time at Emma's birthday, but put too much wasabi on it.

videos.title: Episode 46
videos.overview: Daantje and Gerben see Chantal and Mirthe at the bus stop. Daan is upset. Timon takes Anthony home. Bente also comes to Emma's birthday party.

videos.title: Episode 47
videos.overview: Sander is already having his picture taken, even though the results aren't known yet. Emma is having fun on her birthday and isn't answering Anna's phone.

videos.title: Episode 48
videos.overview: Emma arranges to go swimming with Soraya and Marjolein the next day. Arie is proud of Sander. Jesse prefers his father to stay home.

videos.title: Episode 49
videos.overview: Annemoon decides to connect Jochem's father to her mother. Gerben suggests to Daantje that she should try her hand at flyering as a carrot: it's good money.

videos.title: Episode 50
videos.overview: Jannetje suggests throwing a party at the hangout. The VRijlanders think about who they want to invite. They're each allowed to invite one person to the party.

videos.title: Episode 52
videos.overview: Gerben and Mo are getting the hangout ready for the party and teasing each other about the girls. Annemoon wants to organize a lunch for their parents, but Jochem has to help his father.

videos.title: Episode 53
videos.overview: Timon and Guus escape just in time before Hans and discover a new clue. Anne arrives at Emma's. Wouter tries to befriend Sander, but it's not really working out.

videos.title: Episode 54
videos.overview: Sander arrives at the hangout. Gerben is just leaving to earn money as a carrot. Daantje feels left out at Chantal and Mirthe's. Jesse and Wiebe find a soapbox.

videos.title: Episode 55
videos.overview: Jochem tries to bring his father along to the surprise lunch. Anne makes fun of Bente. Daantje discovers Gerben as a carrot. He tells her he's doing it for her.

videos.title: Episode 56
videos.overview: Sander actually wants to leave, but then Arie asks him to look after the business for a while. Wiebe wants to get on the soapbox. Jesse thinks that's not appropriate, but he can't stop him.

videos.title: Episode 57
videos.overview: Daantje thinks Mirthe doesn't want to go on vacation with her anymore. Gerben thinks she should talk to her. Emma ignores Soraya and Marjolein at the pool.

videos.title: Episode 58
videos.overview: Dinner with Annemoon's mother and Jochem's father has arrived. Daantje asks Mirthe to come along to the party. When Karin gets home, she finds the letters Jesse had hidden.

videos.title: Episode 59
videos.overview: Bente wants to go to the party with Jannetje and Mo, but they quickly promise her a different one. Anne makes fun of Marjolein's corset. Marjolein runs away.

videos.title: Episode 60
videos.overview: Emma is angry with Anne. Chantal shows Gerben how to seduce Mo, but it doesn't work. Soraya can't find Marjolein anywhere.

videos.title: Episode 61
videos.overview: During the party, Wouter and Jannetje discover they both love art. Daantje accompanies Gerben to his caravan. At the party, they play Truth or Dare.

videos.title: Episode 62
videos.overview: Soraya has brought Karin to find Marjolein. Annemoon tells Jochem about her father. Jochem wants to build the time machine to find their parents.

videos.title: Episode 63
videos.overview: Emma tells Wouter about her argument with Anne and that she's afraid she messed things up with Marjolein and Soraya. Sander apologizes to his father. He's being punished.

videos.title: Episode 64
videos.overview: Mo and Gerben talk about the party. Gerben thinks the four of them should do something together: he, Mo, Mirthe, and Daantje. Jochem and Annemoon read letters from her father.

videos.title: Episode 65
videos.overview: Annemoon, Jochem, and Jesse go after Timon and Guus. Gerben and Mo keep it a secret from Sander that Daantje is also going sailing.

videos.title: Episode 66
videos.overview: Emma is practicing twirling and calls Marjolein to make up for it, but she can't answer the phone. Joep and Sander spy on Gerben and Mo.

videos.title: Episode 67
videos.overview: Marjolein and Soraya ask Bente if she wants to twirl with them. Timon and Guus arrive at the cemetery. Jochem, Annemoon, and Jesse are there too.

videos.title: Episode 68
videos.overview: Annemoon and Jesse arrive at Jochem's mother's grave. Annemoon places her lucky stone there. Chantal helps Emma twirl.

videos.title: Episode 69
videos.overview: Daantje and Mirthe arrive at the water's edge. They're surprised to see that Mo has an inflatable boat. Jannetje discovers a beautiful child's drawing by Wouter and thinks it's a shame he's not using it anymore.

videos.title: Episode 70
videos.overview: Mo, Gerben, Daan, and Mirthe decide to have a picnic because the boat is leaking. Marjolein and Soraya go pony riding with Bente.

videos.title: Episode 71
videos.overview: Jannetje paints Wouter's scooter. Melchior doesn't approve. Marjolein and Soraya watch Emma's DVD. Soraya thinks Marjolein should decide if she can join.

videos.title: Episode 72
videos.overview: Jesse, Jochem, and Annemoon examine the new clues. Jesse promises to keep them. They all go home. Mirthe is allowed to stay with Chantal.

videos.title: Episode 73
videos.overview: Mo has found Mirthe's bracelet and comes to give it to her. Hans asks if he's in love with her. Sander is annoyed with Gerben and Daantje. His mother talks to him.

videos.title: Episode 74
videos.overview: A lost boy, Xiao Bao, visits Bente. Bente is going to show him the animals. Wouter receives mail about a boarding school in London.

videos.title: Episode 75
videos.overview: Emma finishes the necklace for her mother. Then her mother cancels. Emma is upset. Jannetje comes into Wouter's room through the window. She has a surprise for him.

videos.title: Episode 76
videos.overview: Emma finishes the necklace for her mother. Then her mother cancels. Emma is upset. Jannetje comes into Wouter's room through the window. She has a surprise for him.

videos.title: Episode 77
videos.overview: Soraya asks if Marjolein already knows if she wants Emma in their twirling group. Daantje is upset that Mirthe is staying with Chantal. She thinks Mirthe has changed.

videos.title: Episode 78
videos.overview: Chantal promises Daantje she'll definitely get the money. Timon and Guus are searching for a clue in the letter they found. Who is Marianne Jacobs?

videos.title: Episode 79
videos.overview: Timon and Guus sneak into the village hall: it's closed. Sander wants to chase away the spring roll stand's customers. Gerben thinks they should first go on a reconnaissance mission: taste the fries.

videos.title: Episode 80
videos.overview: Sander is still at the spring roll stand, plotting revenge. Mo and Gerben want him to give up. Annemoon, Jochem, and Jesse decide to throw a surprise party for Xiao Bao.

videos.title: Episode 81
videos.overview: Timon and Guus search the village hall for clues to Marianne. They find a painting and take it down from the wall. Then Wiebe enters.

videos.title: Episode 82
videos.overview: Jannetje wants Wouter to paint, and Wouter thinks she's nagging. He asks Jannetje about her mother.

videos.title: Episode 83
videos.overview: Jochem is afraid that Mirthe will leave him alone, just like his sister Simone, because Chantal is talking about long-distance modeling trips. Gwen wants to know what's bothering Emma.

videos.title: Episode 84
videos.overview: Sander gives Joep maggots to put in the spring roll cart. Wouter has made a sketch of Jannetje.

videos.title: Episode 85
videos.overview: Jochem, Annemoon, and Jesse decide it's time to move on to the treasure. It turns out the model scout isn't interested in Chantal, but in someone else.

videos.title: Episode 86
videos.overview: Chantal tells Mirthe what happened at the model scout. Jochem suggests that Annemoon write a letter to her father asking if he'll come.

videos.title: Episode 87
videos.overview: Chantal wants to leave VRijland: it's so boring to live there all your life. Jesse takes the book from Timon and Guus, which leads to a chase.

videos.title: Episode 88
videos.overview: Daantje follows a trail of flowers. Melchior asks if Wouter has filled out the school form yet. Wouter promises he'll do it later that day.

videos.title: Episode 89
videos.overview: Sander tells Arie he's going on a trip. Soraya, Emma, ​​and Marjolein practice twirling for the competition and are ridiculed by last year's winners.

videos.title: Episode 90
videos.overview: Emma loses her baton just before their performance. One of the former winners turns out to have it. Mo continues to struggle with Mirthe.

videos.title: Episode 91
videos.overview: Mirthe discovers the washing machine is broken. She wants to ask Mo to fix it. Hans teases her about it. Annemoon finds the typewriter. Jochem starts writing the letter.

videos.title: Episode 92
videos.overview: Mo asks Mirthe about her argument with Daantje and comforts her. Mirthe repairs Mo's overalls. He's impressed. Timon shoots the first penalty: goal.

videos.title: Episode 93
videos.overview: Bao comes to bring Bente presents to thank her. They go on a picnic. Arie wants Daantje to talk things out with Mirthe and get Chantal's money back.

videos.title: Episode 94
videos.overview: Sander asks Joep to gather everyone at the snack bar for his farewell. Chantal promises never to lend her father money again. Gerben finds out from Sander that Daantje is going to become a model.

videos.title: Episode 95
videos.overview: Annemoon and Jochem visit Bente to learn more about the Jacobs family. Daantje calls Mirthe. Chantal is angry that Daantje brought her father into the picture.

videos.title: Episode 96
videos.overview: Annemoon finds a clue in Bente's house. Bao and Bente try to eat nettles. Jannetje puts on makeup for Wouter.

videos.title: Episode 97
videos.overview: Soraya writes a letter to the insurance company because they won't pay for a mobility scooter for Grandma Gwen. Emma asks Melchior if he'll pay for the scooter.

videos.title: Episode 98
videos.overview: Sander is ready to leave, but he's not getting any attention. Melchior asks Wouter about the boarding school form again. Gerben wants to know when Mo is going to ask Mirthe out.

videos.title: Episode 99
videos.overview: Chantal tells Gerben that Daantje is doing a photoshoot. Sander walks out of VRijland, but is followed by Joep, who wants him to stay. Sander doesn't want to go back; he'll look like a fool.

videos.title: Episode 100
videos.overview: Chantal asks Arie for an advance at the snack bar. He refuses. Timon and Guus search Bente's house for a clue. Then Bente enters. The boys flee, but Timon stumbles.

videos.title: Episode 106
videos.overview: Daantje searches for Mirthe at her house and sees her note crumpled on the floor. Melchior confronts Wouter about the letter to the boarding school: does he actually want it?

videos.title: Episode 107
videos.overview: Daantje thinks Mirthe doesn't want anything to do with her anymore and doesn't want to go on vacation. Grandma Gwen has a mobility scooter, and the girls don't understand how she got it.

videos.title: Episode 108
videos.overview: Guus teases Timon: is he in love with Bente? Agnes tells Bente that being weird is sometimes a good thing. Mo decides to find out what girls want.

videos.title: Episode 109
videos.overview: Mo asks Daantje for tips on girls. Chantal and Mirthe try to exchange their clothing vouchers for cash. Jesse and Jochem are busy trying to figure out where the treasure is.

videos.title: Episode 110
videos.overview: Chantal doesn't know what to do with the money. Mirthe reassures her. Sander wants to advertise the snack bar and has a plan. Wouter tells Gerben that he really doesn't understand Jannetje.

videos.title: Episode 111
videos.overview: Daantje asks if she can go on vacation with Gerben. Wouter wants to talk to Jannetje, but Mo advises him against it. Jesse tries to get Bente to tell him about the treasure.

videos.title: Episode 112
videos.overview: Mo gives up on picking up girls, but Daantje has a plan. Sander discovers money missing from the snack bar cash register. Annemoon and Bente try to save the ponies.

videos.title: Episode 113
videos.overview: Mo tries his new approach with the girls. Sander tells Chantal that thirty euros are missing from the snack bar. Soraya, Marjolein, and Emma sell cupcakes.

videos.title: Episode 114
videos.overview: Wouter gives Mo advice about girls. Timon and Guus search the house for the treasure. Soraya realizes she's lost her ring.

videos.title: Episode 115
videos.overview: Soraya gives her mother the money they earned. Sander tells Chantal's mother at the snack bar that there's a thief and asks Spoor to go look for him.

videos.title: Episode 116
videos.overview: Chantal tells Mirte she's going to ask her parents if she can go to France with her. Gerben has an idea for Daantje: why don't you go to sailing camp?

videos.title: Episode 117
videos.overview: Sander installed an alarm in the snack bar, but it won't go off. Hans thinks Mirthe should make things right with Daantje.

videos.title: Episode 118
videos.overview: Mo doesn't know if Mirthe got his invitation. Just as Daantje and Mirthe are about to talk, Chantal comes in to tell them Mirthe can go to France.

videos.title: Episode 119
videos.overview: Chantal is very enthusiastic about France and talks non-stop. Mo is waiting with his picnic.

videos.title: Episode 120
videos.overview: The search for the perpetrator leads to Chantal. Sander refuses to believe this and thinks they should continue their search. Wouter thinks it's nonsense when Jannetje says no one likes her.

videos.title: Episode 127
videos.overview: Daan is just about to sell the boat, but Mirthe wants to stop her. Sander wants Arie to give Chantal a second chance. Bente is ready for the opening of the pony boarding stable.

videos.title: Episode 128
videos.overview: Bente starts the opening, but it's interrupted by a phone call from Wiebe. Wiebe is startled by the call and quickly leaves. Annemoon is upset that her father isn't there.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Chantal has a blind date. Jochem finds dead fish in the ditch and decides to investigate further.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Chantal has a blind date. Jochem finds dead fish in the ditch and decides to investigate further.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: The mayor and his family arrive in Rijland. Jochem and Jip discover what's happening with the water.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: The new mayor and his family visit the farm and Jip and her mother's house. Something goes terribly wrong with her hair...

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Marjolein discovers bumps on her body. The mayor and his family visit the snack bar and the hair salon.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: The mayor's family arrives at the Spoor home, and Chantal does everything she can to look like Valerie. When the mayor and his family later visit the village hall, something terrible happens...

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Victor and Lucas have their first day at the farm. Chantal wants to take tennis lessons from Sander, and Jochem, Jip, and Marjolein are going to investigate why there are dead fish floating in the water.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Jochem, Jip, and Marjolein discover the cause of the dead fish in the pond. Victor and Lucas have a minor accident with the tractor.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Mirthe is furious with Lucas and Victor after the tractor accident. Chantal has a tennis date with Valerie, but when she discovers Valerie's tennis skills, she turns her back on it.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Joep and Timon discover the playground has been cordoned off. Chantal pretends to twist her ankle to avoid playing tennis, and Soraya has to sing on the radio.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Soraya sings for the radio and Mirthe and Daantje give the hangout a drastic makeover.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Daantje and Sander discover that the snack bar is in trouble. Jip, Jochem, and Marjolein have very different problems: where are the dead fish...

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Sander takes delicious revenge on the mayor for closing the terrace. Jesse is allowed to go to soccer camp, but on one condition...

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: Sander has to pay the fines: scrubbing, that is. Jesse has to dance, but that's a real disappointment, and Timon and Joep discover that the playground is closed.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Daan's petition drive isn't going as well as she'd hoped. Soraya is ready for her performance. Will she do it?

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: Sander and Daantje have a bet, and Sander does everything he can to win… Soraya sings her heart out. Just like herself.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: Sander thinks he's won the bet but then he's exposed. Timon still hasn't had any luck with Valerie. And Lucas hasn't with Mirthe.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: Sander proves to be Daantje's savior after all. Lucas and Victor, however, make less of an impression on Mirthe. Chantal catches Timon with a girlie magazine.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: Jip, Jochem, and Marjolein make a discovery in the water. Meanwhile, Karin wonders where Marjolein is. And Chantal wonders what was so great about the Rijland Dance.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: Jip, Jochem, and Marjolein make a big discovery. Lucas and Victor get their jobs back, but then make an even bigger blunder...

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: Victor and Lucas are worried about cow Fien. And about their jobs on the farm. Jesse has his own problem: Chantal wants to do the Rijland Dance...

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: Daantje and Joep are doing everything they can to make the mayor and his wife's visit a success. But whether it will make any difference... Jesse has a sore knee.

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: Jesse doesn't want to dance, but he does want to go to soccer camp... Lucas has a plan to impress Mirthe. But will it work?

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: Lucas's plan to impress Mirthe goes completely awry. And Jesse is also caught out.

videos.title: Episode 25
videos.overview: Timon is on a love path. Victor and Lucas are more on the warpath and Soraya on the path of thieves…

videos.title: Episode 26
videos.overview: Sander and Daantje are vying for the position of snack bar super-scumbag. Victor and Lucas have their own struggles, but when they hear Valerie has a blind date, they become partners in crime again.

videos.title: Episode 27
videos.overview: Daantje and Mirthe want to speak to the mayor, but he refuses them. Valerie meets her blind date...

videos.title: Episode 28
videos.overview: Valerie rejects Timon. But in a very unusual way... Sander turns out not to be as good a supervisor as he thought.

videos.title: Episode 29
videos.overview: Daantje saves the snack bar from a fine and takes over management. Victor has a plan to get closer to Mirthe.

videos.title: Episode 30
videos.overview: Victor discovers his brother is doing everything he can to please Mirthe. He even cheats on his own brother. Sander tries to prevent them from getting a fine for setting up the patio. But whether he'll succeed...

videos.title: Episode 31
videos.overview: Chantal is happy when Valerie agrees to meet her. But things don't quite go according to plan... Jip, Jochem, and Marjolein make a shocking discovery.

videos.title: Episode 32
videos.overview: Chantal is trying to make amends with Valerie, but will she succeed? Jip, Jochem, and Marjolein have much bigger problems...

videos.title: Episode 33
videos.overview: Soraya and Merel get the fright of their lives. Jesse really gets a taste for street dancing. At least, if Chantal doesn't change all the moves again...

videos.title: Episode 34
videos.overview: Chantal is getting herself into more and more trouble with Valerie's awful blouse. Daantje makes a big discovery!

videos.title: Episode 35
videos.overview: Daantje and Mirthe have a plan, and Lucas is allowed to help. Timon and Joep land a job. But are they happy about it?

videos.title: Episode 36
videos.overview: Daantje gets information from an unexpected source. Sander has a brilliant idea to pay off his fine quickly.

videos.title: Episode 37
videos.overview: Victor and Lucas make an appointment. Sanders Snack Service is booming. Only now, it's on a moped, and that's not so...

videos.title: Episode 38
videos.overview: Sander gets caught but doesn't know it yet. And what's Merel up to now?

videos.title: Episode 39
videos.overview: The dance performance is a huge success. However, Mirthe has other things on her mind…

videos.title: Episode 40

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: A new family moves into the village to run Gruwel Geertje's old hotel. Father Toon, mother Maria, the twins Barry and Milou, and Ana and Carmen have come from Argentina to breathe new life into the hotel.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview:
Another new face in the village is Sam. She and her mother Inge have moved to Rijland because Inge is an archaeologist working on a project in the village.

And then we meet Li, who runs the junk shop with his adoptive father, Ouwe Kees.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: When Alfred finally arrives and unveils the statue, everyone is astonished. The statue has a wig and sunglasses! Timon and Joep deny they did it. Alfred is in trouble; if he doesn't put Rijland on the map within three months, he'll be fired! Barry and Milou sneak upstairs and find something! Joep is shocked. Does he see the ghost of Horror Geertje behind the window?!

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Timon and Joep are terrified when Gruwel Geertje appears in the garden! But who is Gruwel Geertje, really? Someone has disguised themselves! Timon and Joep are searching for a treasure, but they don't tell Sam and Marjolein. Barry later stumbles upon some metal in the garden, and Sam thinks it might be the treasure! Victor convinces Alfred not to give up. Together, they also introduce themselves to the new hotel family in Rijland.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Milou keeps asking Victor about his family. Victor doesn't like this and makes a threatening remark about Coco's permits. This frightens Milou! Timon and Joep have a plan to distract everyone so they can dig for the treasure; they trigger the hotel's fire alarm! Sam is looking for teammates to explore what's hidden in the hotel garden. Timon doesn't want to work with Sam; he wants the loot for himself!

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Chaos ensues at the hotel due to the fire alarm, a burnt pan, and unexpected guests! Timon and Joep are digging against something hard—is this the treasure?! They've destroyed all the plants in the garden while digging. Barry is shocked and makes Timon and Joep prove something before they're allowed to dig any further. Chantal is looking for a job and goes to Sam to help with the investigation. But as soon as Chantal hears she'll encounter vermin, she quickly quits. And do Timon and Joep really eat worms?

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Milou has to babysit guest Spencer, but isn't that fun? Milou also gets a bad feeling when Victor lashes out at her.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Milou is furious with Victor and completely loses trust in him. Timon and Joep sound the alarm. They hope to become rich and famous from their garden find. Toon panics...

videos.overview: Sam wants to take a picture of the bomb, but Inge can't know. Marjolein makes a deal with Sam and helps her with the photo.

videos.overview: Sam has found Lurkje, and Marjolein would never leave without her teddy bear. Milou and Lodewijk devise a plan to stop the contracts from being signed.

videos.title: Episode 113
videos.overview: Chantal and Timon pursue their mother. Lodewijk and Milou think their plan has worked, but Alfred has another idea.

videos.title: Episode 114
videos.overview: Chantal and Timon have proof that Wiebe is involved with their mother and want to tell their father. Sam gives up, Rijland is lost. Marjolein doesn't give up...

videos.title: Episode 115
videos.overview: Julia and Jesse are bored. Julia wants to do something exciting, but then Grandma comes over.

videos.title: Episode 116
videos.overview: Timon and Joep are done carrying things, but they can immediately start a new job. Inge and Alfred ask Victor and Sam to be bridesmaids and pageboys...

videos.title: Episode 117
videos.overview: Timon and Joep have botched their job and lost all their money. Fortunately, a lifesaver quickly arrives.

videos.title: Episode 118
videos.overview: Today is the big day: Alfred and Inge are getting married. Li and Old Kees are on their way to the wedding when Kees rips his pants. He goes back to get a new pair...

videos.title: Episode 119
videos.overview: Inge is completely distraught when she discovers what Alfred has done. When Marjolein arrives at the junk shop, she hears from Li that Old Kees has had an accident.

videos.title: Episode 120
videos.overview: Inge and Sam go talk to Alfred. Victor visits Old Kees to get him to sign the contract after all. Timon and Joep get behind the wheel of the police car...

videos.title: Episode 121
videos.overview: Spoor is distraught when he discovers his car is missing. Milou is visited by an old, strange man named Max.

videos.title: Episode 122
videos.overview: Timon and Joep are furious, Spoor has caught them. The occupiers won't leave the junk shop, and the deputy is threatening harsh measures.

videos.title: Episode 123
videos.overview: Lodewijk hears from Maria and Milou that Max is confused and that Grandma Geertje wasn't a painter after all. Jesse and Pip are busy distributing food parcels.

videos.title: Episode 124
videos.overview: The occupiers go to Alfred's house. The contracts must be torn up! Pip and Jesse try to lure the respectable woman into a trap.

videos.title: Episode 125
videos.overview: Everyone leaves the mayor's house. They all give up. Milou and Lodewijk are helping Mario pack when they make a remarkable discovery.

videos.title: Episode 127
videos.overview: Milou wants to sell Grandma Geertje's painting. Lodewijk thinks it's a shame; it's such a beautiful painting. Timon and Joep offer Roberta a photoshoot.

videos.title: Episode 128
videos.overview: Chantal, Li, Barry, Sam, and Julia are still trying to steal the deputy's briefcase. Will they succeed this time? Lodewijk has a plan to ensure that Milou...

videos.title: Episode 129
videos.overview: Milou is shocked when she hears from Maria and Toon that they can already move into their new house. The deputy realizes his suitcase has been swapped. But he laughs...

videos.title: Episode 130
videos.overview: Sam isn't sure she can trust Victor, but they have nothing left to lose. Milou and Lodewijk have hung all the artwork. The exhibition is ready...

videos.title: Episode 131
videos.overview: The deputy realizes that Victor can't be trusted either. He locks him up along with his father. Marjolein, Sam, Barry, and Li ask the neighbors to join them...

videos.title: Episode 132
videos.overview: Chantal has no intention of giving up Rijland. She devises a new plan to stop the bulldozers. Will she succeed?

videos.title: Episode 133
videos.overview: The Rijlanders continue to demonstrate. Will they succeed in saving Rijland?

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Anton wants the children to care for his animals because that way it's done properly. They do have to pay rent and get their parents' permission. They're going to ask for it.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Rico catches Chantal and Pip searching for news. They talk their way out of it, but don't give up. Louis gets a heavy-duty tent from Alfred for his base camp.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Tom and Louis are allowed to pitch the tent at the farm, but it doesn't quite work out. The tent isn't quite complete. Roos comes up with a solution.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Under Milou's guidance, the children make a plan to arrange food for the animals. The deputy has news for Chantal. She has high expectations.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: If the kids pay the rent, the deputy can't do anything to them. They come up with all sorts of ways to raise the money.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Anna and Marjolein receive food for Alfred's animals, but they have to give something in return. Milou is stuck and screams for help. Will anyone hear her?

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Chantal is making a segment about the billiards club, but not quite the way Pip had envisioned it. Roos wants Lodewijk's attention, but he's mainly focused on Milou, who's stuck.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Fajah also comes to see the farm and runs into a problem. She wants a tour of the farm from Marjolein, but they have to leave the room where Milou is stuck...

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Rico and Mark, thanks to Chantal, uncover something very big. Anna helps cover up Milou's fall, until she suddenly has to stop.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Toon has had enough and goes looking for Milou. Will Milou be rescued in time?

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Louis doesn't want Marjolein constantly coming onto his property and comes up with a plan. The farm rent needs to be paid, but how are they going to do that?

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: Rose finally gets to see her portrait, but it wasn't the one she'd hoped for. Anna suddenly hears something strange while they're making herbal potions...

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Bellefleur turns out to be a mysterious person, but as soon as Lodewijk enters, Anna immediately keeps her mouth shut about Bellefleur. Chantal doesn't notice a studio with chickens on the farm...

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: When Chantal finds out that Rico has found a potential treasure, she immediately wants to break it as breaking news. Milou wants Chantal to keep quiet...

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: When Chantal decides to broadcast about the treasure, Rico puts a stop to it. Bellefleur is sought, but Anna keeps her mouth shut.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: Bellefleur explains why she wants to remain a secret. Milou and Anna think Professor Tournesol is a thief and tie him up.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: Roos wants her mother to run for mayor. Lodewijk has trouble painting Goldie's eyes and is surprised...

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: Lodewijk doesn't want Milou to see Goldie's painting and offers to paint vases. According to Anna's tarot cards, Pip will become famous. Simone wants to be mayor...

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: Lodewijk sold his painted vases to Simone for 100 euros, pretending they were authentic oriental vases. Marjolein picked up the stove...

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: Because something happened to Chantal, Pip temporarily took over the TokTok show. Barry and Marjolein did everything they could to stop the smoke.

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: Marjolein has blocked the shed door. Tom and Louis aren't allowed out until they apologize. Milou is furious with Louis about the vases.

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: Roos offers Louis a new base camp, but she wants something in return. Chantal isn't happy with Barry's commercial and is holding new auditions.

videos.title: Episode 25
videos.overview: Roos wants to make the animals sick so the children can no longer care for them. Barry makes a new commercial that actually airs!

videos.title: Episode 26
videos.overview: Bellefleur goes out with her father, until he notices something unusual again. Rico and Bellefleur seem to really like each other... Chantal is disappointed...

videos.title: Episode 27
videos.overview: Milou wants Lodewijk to paint Hetty the pig, but she doesn't know that Lodewijk can't paint eyes. Chantal is no longer interested in the TokTok show...

videos.title: Episode 28
videos.overview: The farm animals are getting sick from Roos and Louis's poison. Marjolein openly admits that Barry's cake isn't good.

videos.title: Episode 29
videos.overview: Milou thinks the animals got sick from Barry's cake. Anna is no longer allowed on her mother's farm, so she goes to get Anna.

videos.title: Episode 30
videos.overview: Anna thinks Roos has made the animals sick. Roos discovers that the animals are much sicker than intended and she urgently needs the antiserum.

videos.title: Episode 31
videos.overview: Roos persuades Tom not to mention the poison. Louis manages to obtain the antidote without being seen, and Louis no longer wants to appear in the documentary.

videos.title: Episode 32
videos.overview: Bellefleur secretly tries to paint the cow's eyes, but Milou catches her. Milou expects Lodewijk to confess that he didn't paint Goldie's eyes himself...

videos.title: Episode 33
videos.overview: Everyone is in shock that the animals have to go. Louis has submitted the antidote, but will he be there in time?

videos.title: Episode 34
videos.overview: Bellefleur and Rico have found something underground and call Marc and Professor Tournesol. Milou watches the TokTokshow about Lodewijk.

videos.title: Episode 35
videos.overview: Louis and Roos go to the farm to sabotage things. Tom isn't allowed to come along. Anna discovers that the deputy wants to build an organic farm.

videos.title: Episode 36
videos.overview: The B&B police arrive. When Barry and Marjolein's B&B receives a bad review, they have to close it. Louis and Roos throw horse manure on the bed...

videos.title: Episode 37
videos.overview: Lodewijk is staying with Old Claus and won't be back for a while. Chantal wants him back to the farm so they can finish their film.

videos.title: Episode 38
videos.overview: Roos and Louis steal Barry's breakfast. Chantal and Pip show Milou's video message to Lodewijk. What will Lodewijk do?

videos.title: Episode 39
videos.overview: Tom finds Roos and Louis in the closet. Lodewijk doesn't want to come back, and Milou sells Goldie's painting because she's angry with Lodewijk.

videos.title: Episode 40
videos.overview: The breakfast Barry had in mind is nowhere to be found. They're going to have breakfast together at the farm, and they're having a blast!

videos.title: Episode 41
videos.overview: The kids need Lodewijk to make pig masks. They ask Milou to persuade him. Chantal secretly films the whole thing.

videos.title: Episode 42
videos.overview: Milou and Lodewijk are doing well. Anna's plan to scare the deputy worked. Marjolein discovers the mask is gone.

videos.title: Episode 43
videos.overview: Anna is panicking because the mask is missing. Rico is preparing all the effects in case the deputy arrives. Milou has to keep the deputy busy.

videos.title: Episode 44
videos.overview: The deputy is scared. What should he do? The oracle speaks and threatens further.

videos.title: Episode 45
videos.overview: Rico and Bellefleur find a Roman amphora and are happy.

videos.title: Episode 46
videos.overview: Chantal is enthusiastic about her election coverage. Until Pip makes it clear to her that there's little to be gained by having just one candidate...

videos.title: Episode 47
videos.overview: Roos and Simone are shocked when the deputy withdraws his deal and refuses to give Simone any money. He no longer wants a factory farm.

videos.title: Episode 48
videos.overview: Milou and Marjolein put up posters about the oracle around the village. Spoor won't let them. They explain that the oracle can make you happier. Spoor doesn't believe it.

videos.title: Episode 49
videos.overview: Tom teaches Alfred to play golf. It's not going very well. They challenge Louis to try it too. He can't do it either.

videos.title: Episode 50
videos.overview: The kids present the oracle. Spoor begins. Then Karin... The oracle knows a lot. The Rijlanders seem to be starting to believe it. When everyone's gone, the kids are happy...

videos.title: Episode 51
videos.overview: Bellefleur is with Lodewijk and feels like they're being watched. And they are. Lodewijk spills something on his painting, and Bellefleur gets a cloth.

videos.title: Episode 53
videos.overview: Bellefleur is with Lodewijk and feels like they're being watched. And they are. Lodewijk spills something on his painting, and Bellefleur gets a cloth.

videos.title: Episode 54
videos.overview: Chantal comes up with a mystery candidate. Pip wants them to tell Roberta the truth. She even paid for the film. Chantal wants the job, but Pip wants fun things...

videos.title: Episode 55
videos.overview: Pip packs her things. She talks to herself furiously. Then she finds a rabbit. Anna arrives, also looking for the rabbit named Elvis.

videos.title: Episode 56
videos.overview: Milou and Marjolein have a total of €601.25. Enough! The deputy comes to collect money. But the suit cost €700, so they're €550 short.

videos.title: Episode 57
videos.overview: Chantal and Roos might want to work together.

videos.title: Episode 58
videos.overview: Rico suggests to Bellefleur that her father, Mark, is acting strangely. This creates tension between them. Then Grandpa Tournesol enters.

videos.title: Episode 59
videos.overview: Alfred enters the B&B. He wants to relax and read. That's not the plan... He has to milk the milk for his own coffee. But Alfred isn't keen on that.

videos.title: Episode 60
videos.overview: Outside, Lodewijk pretends to twist his ankle. Alfred stops to help. Then he briefly goes to help Milou with the work.

videos.title: Episode 61
videos.overview: Barry and Marjolein watch Chantal's program with frustration and argue. Marjolein blames Barry but then apologizes. She's upset about losing the farm...

videos.title: Episode 62
videos.overview: Marjolein, Barry, and Milou are thrilled when they hear on Chantal's show that Alfred is running. Milou does a great impression of the queen.

videos.title: Episode 63
videos.overview: Bellefleur and Rico realize they're wrong. Mark was busy preparing something for Bellefleur. Rico begins to doubt his guilt.

videos.title: Episode 65
videos.overview: Lodewijk gets a call from the real queen, but doesn't believe it at first. He hangs up. Then he realizes it couldn't be Milou. Gulp... Then she calls back.

videos.title: Episode 66
videos.overview: Mark is still busy with the map. Tournesol wants it back. Bellefleur explains to her father what she wants: attention from her father. Rico stands up for Mark.

videos.title: Episode 67
videos.overview: Louis and Tom are working on the farm. But with what? They hide when the demolition crew enters the barn and plants dynamite. They dismantle it immediately.
